summary: The proof is correct and complete. The Jacobian and trapezoid width identity are exact; the predecessor lobe bounds apply; concavity yields the stated cap, width, and connector-area bounds including support and vertical-face degeneracies; the relaxed endpoint-width minimization has the correct exhaustive cases; and the final one-variable lower bound is strictly greater than 3/2. The Regime-A parameter reduction and general localization theorem then exclude a strict counterexample.
